issues.description: The type of Person.birthday is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template common Person model declare birthday as java.time.LocalDate, but the solution's common Person model declares birthday as String. The solution's PersonScene (client UI) still treats birthday as LocalDate and calls setBirthday(LocalDate), which is incompatible with the solution Person model and will cause compilation errors and student confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably restore birthday to java.time.LocalDate in the solution common Person model to match the problem statement and the client UI (PersonScene and other client code). Update any server-side JSON handling or sorting logic to work with LocalDate (e.g., ensure correct JSON serialization/deserialization and adjust comparisons in PersonService). Alternatively, if String is intended, update the client code (PersonScene and controllers) to convert LocalDate to/from String consistently and update the problem statement to reflect the String type.
